decision_conditions: In the absence of detailed specifications for the proposed mitigation measures having been provided, including construction details such as layouts, cross-sections, and manufacturer specifications to ensure clarity on how the proposed measures will be implemented on site, the submitted details would fail to demonstrate how the development would minimise the risk of flooding, contrary to the objectives of Policy LP53 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).

In the absence of detailed specifications for the proposed SUDS measures having been provided, including the attenuation volume/capacity and manufacturer’s product specification for the selected rainwater butt, a site-specific cross-section of the permeable paving confirming the construction build-up, sub-base depth, void ratio, geotextile/separation layers, and underdrain/outlet arrangement, the submitted details would fail to demonstrate how the development would reduce surface water on and surrounding the site, contrary to the objectives of Policy LP53 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).

In the absence of detailed specifications for the proposed cycle storage having been provided, including the height, storage capacity and material finish of the cycle stores, the submitted details would fail to demonstrate how the development would provide secure, covered and accessible cycle parking for 5 cycles, contrary to the objectives of Policy LP42 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
